_: The font pack the web target may embed. One entry per family: `family` is the CSS name, `file` the woff2 next to this file, `heavy` the weight to use where the design asks for a heavy face (a single-weight face has to stay at 400 or the browser fakes the bold), `stack` the system fallback, `licence` the file that must travel with the font. Add a family here and its two files, never a URL: tools/build/build.mjs embeds the bytes as base64, so a game never fetches a font.

orbitron.note: squarish sci-fi, wide counters — reads at a glance in caps

exo2.note: technical but humanist — the neutral one of the pack

baloo2.note: rounded and warm — for a friendly, cartoon game

bungee.note: arcade signage, one weight only — already ultra bold

bebasneue.note: tall condensed caps, one weight — poster and casino

russoone.note: industrial, machined — for gears and metal
